body.name: \mathsf{Comp}_3(z)
body.def: \(\mathsf{Comp}_3(z)\) requires one joint law of \(G\) and all regime-path potential outcomes to project to the observed law of \(\mathfrak W_3\), to satisfy \(E_P[Y_2(p^\infty)\mid G=h]=2\) and \(E_P[Y_3(p^\infty)\mid G=h]=2-z\) for \(h\in\{4,5,6\}\), and to realize \((a_{4,3},a_{5,3},a_{6,3})=(z+1/2,z,z)\) with \(a_{h,2}=0\).
body.role: Explicit regime-path potential-outcome completion target associated with the worked observed law.
